title: Google Calendar
description: Creates an event in a Google Calendar.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Google Calendar connection used to create the event.

calendarId.title: Calendar ID
calendarId.description: Calendar to add the event to. Defaults to the primary calendar.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start as an RFC 3339 date-time (2026-10-05T09:00:00+07:00) or an all-day date (2026-10-05). A date-time without an offset needs a time zone.

end.title: End
end.description: End in the same format as the start; it must be after the start. For all-day events the end date is exclusive.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone name (for example Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). Needed when the start has no UTC offset.

sendInvitations.title: Send invitations
sendInvitations.description: Email invitations to the attendees. Off by default: attendees are added to the event without an email.
